summary: Executed full backend+frontend regression on public preview URL for homepage storytelling, demo workspace, motion controls, waitlist/newsletter integrations, navigation, responsiveness, and API contracts.

ui_bugs.issue: 14 interactive footer links/buttons are missing data-testid attributes, violating required testability standard for primary interactive elements.

integration_issues.issue: Browser console logs repeated SVG parse errors: invalid <path d> arc syntax in exported demo pages/shared sidebar icon markup.

action_items: Add unique data-testid attributes to all missing primary interactive footer links/buttons in SiteChrome.
Fix malformed SVG path data in exported demo shared sidebar icon markup (shared.js) to remove repeated console errors.
Optional hardening: reduce noisy abort logs from interrupted ASCII asset fetches during rapid navigation/reload transitions.
critical_code_review_comments: shared.js includes malformed SVG path data in nav icon strings (console parse errors repeat across demo pages).
Primary interactive links in footer Learn/Trust/Legal columns do not meet data-testid requirement declared for testability/automation.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md (no auth required for this app).
seed_data_creation: Created unique waitlist/newsletter entries via public /api/waitlist and /api/newsletter during UI/API validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core user journeys pass: 12 homepage sections render, header nav works, motion toggle persists, watch-demo anchor reaches embedded /demo/demopages/home.html iframe, scene tabs/guided tour work, /demo route works, waitlist/newsletter submissions pass including newsletter idempotency, mobile/tablet overflow is zero. Remaining regressions are missing data-testid on footer interactive links and repeated SVG path console errors from exported demo shared script.
rca of the issue: RCA-1: Missing data-testid issue is caused by footer directory links in SiteChrome not being annotated while nearby interactive elements are. RCA-2: Console error originates from malformed SVG path commands in exported demo shared icon strings (shared.js navItems), reproducible on every demo scene load; fix path syntax to valid SVG commands.
